answer: Registration is a scarce lease, not a free login. An applicant locks 2,800 POA for 12 days and publishes a vertex identifier bound to one funding source. Until that lock matures, spendable earnings sit at a nadir of zero. If two leases collapse to the same wallet cluster or device fingerprint, both bonds are slashed in full and the names are burned. Inspectors publish a crystal of those lease hashes each epoch, so minting 500 aliases costs 1.4 million POA and 12 days of idle capital before any reward can move.
